import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc['word/document.xml']

# Print all paragraphs with their pStyle and first 80 chars of text
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName('w:p')
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    styles = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
    style = styles[0].getAttribute('w:val') if styles else '(none)'
    # gather text
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else '')
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:delText'):
        texts.append('[DEL:' + (t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else '') + ']')
    text = ''.join(texts)[:100]
    print(f'P{i:03d} style={style:20s} text={text!r}')
